newsitem.title: GERMANY: R & M sets capital raise at 140 DM/shr.
newsitem.headline: R & M sets capital raise at 140 DM/shr.

text.p: German specialist construction company Rheinhold & Mahla AG on Monday said it would price its rights issue of 3.6 million marks nominal in new equity at 140 marks per share.

One new share will be issued for every 10 already in circulation, raising total equity capital to 39.6 million marks nominal. Shareholders will be able to take up their rights between September 23 and October 8, the company said.
Rheinhold & Mahla first announced the capital raise at its annual general meeting in July after saying it expected to suffer a loss this year and cancel its dividend.
The company's main shareholders, the Illbruck and Greiler families and the Bayerischen Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank, have guaranteed to take up the issue, chief executive Franz Greiler has said.
Rheinhold & Mahla shares finished last week at 149 marks.
